description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaKeysModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC component. It includes class declarations for the service interface and its factory, along with methods for client connection management.

classes.name: IMediaKeysModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaKeysModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the Media Keys Module Service, managing client connections.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaKeysModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaKeysModuleService instance given a reference to ICdmService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection to the IPC service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection of a client from the IPC service.
